Training workshops

Giving a fish is good. Learning to fish together is better. Our free workshops help people become more self-reliant.

Four formats

Workshops

Small, hands-on groups where you leave with a practical tool.

Seminars

Half a day to explore a topic in depth with guest speakers.

Talks

Testimonies and experts to inspire and inform.

Awareness campaigns

In churches, schools and on the street, to make the needs of the most vulnerable known.

Upcoming workshops

Free and open to all. Registration recommended.
